 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026, Release Date, Merit List PDF & Cutoff
 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026 will be declared officially by the Staff Selection Commission on its web portal at ssc.gov.in in November/December 2026 . SSC provides level-wise merit lists containing shortlisted candidate roll numbers across Matriculation, Higher Secondary, and Graduation posts.

 What After SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026? 
 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) completed the Computer-Based Examination (CBE) for Phase-XIV/2026/Selection Posts across the country between September 16 and September 26, 2026 . Following the release of the provisional answer key on October 9, 2026, the Commission is evaluating candidate responses to declare the official SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026.
 As of the current verified status, the final result has not been declared yet. Candidates who appeared for 2,919 vacancies across Matriculation, Higher Secondary (10+2), and Graduation & Above levels can track this page to access direct PDF links, level-wise cut-off marks, and document scrutiny instructions upon official publication on ssc.gov.in.

 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026 Release Date
 The Staff Selection Commission publishes candidate selection lists following the complete resolution of answer key objections. Based on historical result processing cycles, the SSC Selection Post Phase 14 result release date is anticipated in November or December 2026.
 Candidates should note that November/December 2026 remains an estimated processing window and does not constitute an officially binding date until confirmed by the Commission via a formal notification on ssc.gov.in. The provisional answer key challenge window closed in mid-October 2026, paving the way for normalisation and final merit computation.
 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026 PDF Download Link
 Once published by the Examination Division, the direct SSC Selection Post Phase 14 result link will be activated under the "Results" portal on the official website. The Commission releases separate merit PDF documents based on educational qualification tiers:
 Matriculation Level Result PDF: Shortlisted candidates for 10th-pass posts (e.g., MTS, Office Attendant, Field Attendant).
 Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Result PDF: Shortlisted candidates for 12th-pass posts (e.g., DEO, LDC, Junior Secretariat Assistant).
 Graduation & Above Level Result PDF: Shortlisted candidates for Graduate posts (e.g., Assistant Section Officer, Inspector, Auditor).
 How to Download SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026?
 Candidates can complete their SSC Selection Post Phase 14 result download by following these steps:
 1. Visit the Official Website: 
 Open your browser and navigate to ssc.gov.in.
 2. Open the Results Section: 
 Click on the " Results " icon located on the main portal navigation bar.
 3. Select Others / Selection Post Section: 
 Navigate to the " Others" or " Selection Post " sub-category tab.
 4. Locate Phase 14 Result PDF: 
 Look for the notification titled " Phase-XIV/2026/Selection Posts Result - Shortlisted Candidates for Next Stage of Scrutiny " corresponding to your educational level (Matriculation, 10+2, or Graduation).
 5. Check Shortlisting Status: 
 Open the downloaded PDF file, press Ctrl + F (or search in mobile PDF viewers), and enter your Roll Number or Registration Number to check your status.
 Details Mentioned in SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result
 The official SSC Phase 14 result 2026 notification contains comprehensive candidate and post-level information. When opening the PDF, candidates should verify the following details:
 Header Particulars: Examination Name (Phase-XIV/2026/Selection Posts), Qualification Level, and Notification Number.
 Post Details: Specific Post Category Code (e.g., NR10126, CR10726), Post Name, and Requisitioning Department.
 Candidate Identifiers: Candidate Roll Number, Candidate Name (where provided in complete lists), and Category under which qualified (UR, SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PwBD, ESM).
 Cut-off Parameters: Marks scored by the last shortlisted candidate in Part A, Part B, and Total Normalised Marks.
 Shortlisting Ratios: Total number of candidates qualified against the post category for document scrutiny.
 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Cut Off 2026
 The Commission declares post-wise and category-wise cut-off thresholds along with the declaration of shortlisted candidates. Because Selection Post recruitment spans multiple distinct post codes across regional offices (NR, CR, WR, ER, SR, etc.), SSC Selection Post Phase 14 cut off marks vary significantly based on:
 Specific technical qualifications or experience required for the post.
 Number of vacancies allocated to a specific post code.
 Applied candidate volume and CBT performance distribution.
 The minimum qualifying percentage thresholds established by the Commission prior to normalisation are:
 Candidate Category 
 Minimum Qualifying Percentage in CBT 
 Unreserved (UR) 
 30% (60 out of 200 Marks) 
 OBC / EWS 
 25% (50 out of 200 Marks) 
 All Other Reserved Categories (SC, ST, PwBD, ESM) 
 20% (40 out of 200 Marks) 
 T he actual operational cut-off marks for document scrutiny are higher than the baseline qualifying percentage due to competitive merit ranking. 
 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Merit List 2026
 The SSC Selection Post Phase 14 merit list PDF is prepared based on normalised candidate marks in the Computer-Based Examination. Because multiple candidates apply for distinct departmental posts, the Commission does not publish a single combined national merit list.
 Instead, candidate shortlisting is executed post-code-wise in a specific ratio:
 Posts with up to 5 Vacancies: Candidates shortlisted in a 1:30 ratio (30 candidates per vacancy).
 Posts with more than 5 Vacancies: Candidates shortlisted in a 1:15 ratio (15 candidates per vacancy, minimum 150).
 Candidates appearing in the SSC Selection Post Phase 14 shortlisted candidates list earn eligibility to submit physical copies of their application form and certificates for document scrutiny.
 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Selection Process After Result
 Understanding the SSC Selection Post Phase 14 selection process after clearing the Computer-Based Examination helps candidates prepare their dossiers in advance.
 Computer-Based Examination (CBT)               
 Declaration of Level-Wise CBT Results & Cut-Off                
 Document Scrutiny (Submission of Hard Copies to Regional Offices)               
 Conduct of Skill Test / Data Entry / Trade Test (For Specific Post Codes)                
 Final Selection List & Allocation to Requisitioning Departments
 What After SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026?
 After the declaration of the SSC Phase 14 result 2026, candidates who find their roll numbers in the merit PDF should immediately perform the following actionable steps:
 Download & Save the Result PDF: Keep a copy of the official result notice and post-wise cut-off list for future reference.
 Obtain Printout of Application Form: Log in to your profile on ssc.gov.in and download a fresh copy of your Phase-XIV/2026 application form.
 Assemble Hard Copies for Dossier: Compile self-attested copies of Class 10 marksheets, essential qualification degree/diploma certificates, experience certificates, valid category certificates (OBC-NCL, EWS, SC/ST), and photo identity proof.
 Track Regional Web Notices: Monitor the specific regional SSC portal (e.g., SSCNR, SSCCR, SSCWR) under which your applied post code falls for postal dispatch submission deadlines and document verification dates.

 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026 FAQs
 When will the SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026 be declared?
 SSC Selection Post Phase 14 Result 2026 is expected to be released in November or December 2026 on ssc.gov.in. Where can I check my SSC Phase 14 result on the official website?
 You can check and download the result PDF directly from the Results section of the official website at ssc.gov.in. Is there an interview stage after the SSC Selection Post Phase 14 result?
 No. There is no interview for Selection Post recruitment. Selection depends on CBT merit, document scrutiny, and qualifying skill tests (where prescribed). What is the ratio of candidates shortlisted for document scrutiny?
 Candidates are shortlisted in a 1:30 ratio for posts with up to 5 vacancies and a 1:15 ratio for posts with more than 5 vacancies. Have questions about your prep?
